problems.title: Implement LRU Cache
problems.description:
Implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with the following requirements:
1. Initialize with a capacity
2. get(key) - Return value if exists, else -1. Mark as recently used.
3. put(key, value) - Insert/update. Evict LRU item if at capacity.
4. O(1) time complexity for both operations
5. Include type hints and docstrings
hints: Consider using OrderedDict or doubly-linked list + hashmap

problems.title: REST API Client with Retry Logic
problems.description:
Implement a robust REST API client class that:
1. Supports GET, POST, PUT, DELETE methods
2. Implements exponential backoff retry (max 3 retries)
3. Handles rate limiting (429 status) with Retry-After header
4. Includes request/response logging
5. Supports timeout configuration
6. Returns typed response objects
7. Raises custom exceptions for different error types

problems.title: Design a Rate Limiter
problems.description:
Design and implement a distributed-ready rate limiter:
1. Support multiple algorithms: Token Bucket, Sliding Window
2. Configurable: requests per second/minute/hour
3. Support multiple keys (e.g., per-user, per-IP)
4. Thread-safe implementation
5. Include a decorator for easy function rate limiting
6. Provide async support
7. Include metrics: total requests, allowed, denied, current rate

problems.title: Debug Async Race Condition
problems.description:
The following async code has race conditions and bugs. Find and fix all issues:
1. Identify the race condition(s)
2. Fix the concurrent counter bug
3. Handle task cancellation properly
4. Fix the deadlock potential
5. Add proper error propagation
6. Ensure all resources are cleaned up
problems.starter_code:
import asyncio
from typing import List, Dict

class AsyncProcessor:
    def __init__(self):
        self.results: Dict[str, int] = {}
        self.counter = 0
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
    
    async def process_item(self, item_id: str, value: int) -> int:
        # Bug: counter increment is not atomic
        self.counter += 1
        
        # Simulate async work
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
        
        # Bug: potential race condition on results dict
        self.results[item_id] = value * 2
        
        return self.results[item_id]
    
    async def process_batch(self, items: List[tuple]) -> Dict[str, int]:
        # Bug: no error handling for failed tasks
        tasks = [self.process_item(id, val) for id, val in items]
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        return self.results
    
    async def process_with_lock(self, item_id: str, value: int) -> int:
        # Bug: potential deadlock - nested lock acquisition
        async with self.lock:
            result = await self.process_item(item_id, value)
            async with self.lock:  # Deadlock!
                self.results[f'{item_id}_verified'] = result
        return result
